questions.question: Choose the correct form of the verb in brackets to complete the sentence: She said that she (have) ________ seen that film before.
Select the correct reported speech form: 'I really enjoyed the concert,' he said to me.
options: He said that he had really enjoyed the concert.
He said that he had really enjoyed the concert.
He said that he really enjoyed the concert.
He said that he would really enjoy the concert.
questions.answer: He said that he had really enjoyed the concert.

questions.question: Which option correctly reports the following direct speech? 'If I were you, I would take that job,' she advised him.
options: She said that if she were him, she would take that job.
She said that if she were him, she would take that job.
She said that if she were he, she would take that job.
She said that if she were he, she would take that job.
questions.answer: She said that if she were he, she would take that job.

questions.question: Choose the correct passive form: The report (complete) ________ by the end of the week.
Select the correct option to complete the sentence: By the time we arrived, the train ________ .
Which of these sentences uses the correct form of the conditional?
options: If I had studied harder, I would have passed the exam.
If I had studied harder, I would pass the exam.
If I had studied harder, I would have passed the exam.
If I had studied harder, I will have passed the exam.
questions.answer: If I had studied harder, I would have passed the exam.

questions.question: Choose the best collocation: It’s important to maintain a good ________ with your colleagues.
Select the correct dependent preposition: We decided to postpone the meeting ________ bad weather.
Which sentence correctly uses the discourse marker to introduce a new idea?
options: Moreover, the results were even better than expected.
However, the results were even better than expected.
Therefore, the results were even better than expected.
Nevertheless, the results were even better than expected.
questions.answer: Moreover, the results were even better than expected.
